label: Pinterest
terms_note: Free; business account + OAuth 2.0 app; scopes pins:write, pins:read, boards:read, boards:write (org_write for business-access); new apps start in TRIAL access (low per-day call limits, own account only) and must apply for STANDARD access with an app review — the rate-limit and get-access pages sit behind a CAPTCHA today so the exact trial numbers were not re-read; sandbox supported for pins/create; 'intended solely for publishing new content created by the user' — curated saves must use the Save button, not the API.

reference.limits: - 429 "The user has sent too many requests" per rate-limit category (per-user per-minute buckets; trial tier far lower than standard). Sandbox enabled for pins/create. - No comments API, no scheduling parameter (platform-side scheduler). - Free; Developer Guidelines forbid saving other people's content through the API (use the Save button).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token (pinr…) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, boards:read, pins:read and pins:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600).

config_fields.name: board_id
config_fields.help: Board id new Pins are created on (GET /v5/boards).

me.note: Get user account: username, account_type, business_name, profile_image.

publish_image.note: Creates a Pin on config board_id from the first image URL (media_source {source_type: image_url, url}); `text` becomes the description.

delete.note: Deletes a Pin owned by the user (204).

analytics_post.note: Get Pin with pin_metrics=true: 'Specify whether to return 90d and lifetime Pin metrics' — metrics carries 90d and lifetime_metrics (pin_click, impression, clickthrough, …).

not_offered.publish_text: A Pin always needs `media_source` (PinCreate requires media_source; https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5/pins-create).
not_offered.read_comments: The v5 API has no comment endpoints (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml).
not_offered.reply_comment: The v5 API has no comment endpoints (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml).
not_offered.read_mentions: The v5 API has no mention or notification endpoint (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml).

evidence: host api.pinterest.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: POST /v5/oauth/token answered 500 code 12 for a numeric dummy client id and 401 'Authentication failed' for a non-numeric one (checked by hand), so the token endpoint is live; the 500 is Pinterest's handling of an unknown app id.
